nodes.description: Mapping of holder balances; written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Nested mapping of spenders' allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress and read in ensure().
Mapping whitelisting addresses that bypass the condition() check in ensure().
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Minimum sale value computed with unchecked multiplication in init().
Maximum sale value computed with unchecked multiplication in init().
Maximum number of sales per address enforced by condition().
Total token supply assigned to the owner in the constructor.
Token decimals constant (18) used in init() scaling.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom with unchecked allowance/balance updates and whitelist bypass via ensure().
Internal whitelist check comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale.
Public payable approve writing the allowance of msg.sender.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with data b.
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale/_maxSale with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only batch transfer using unchecked arithmetic and duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure().
Constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender and setting it as owner.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance checks and balance writes.
Low-level delegatecall to a user-supplied address enabling arbitrary code execution in the contract context.
allowance and balanceOf updates inside transferFrom use unchecked subtraction and addition.
_value * _tos.length and the balance updates inside batchSend are unchecked.
token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) multiplications inside init can overflow.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of the delegated transferFrom call.
msg.sender determines the spender allowance check and is the caller of the transfer.
approve stores the allowance of msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it.
transferFrom performs allowance and balance updates with unchecked subtraction.
batchSend performs total and balance computations without SafeMath.
init multiplies user-supplied token amounts by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
balanceOf mapping is read and written inside transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and written inside transferFrom.
ensure consults the caller's balance-based sale eligibility.
ensure compares _from/_to against owner to grant a whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress to grant a whitelist bypass.
ensure consults canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
transfer indirectly manipulates balanceOf through transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
init is gated by the owner state variable.
delegate is gated by the owner state variable.
batchSend is gated by the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress is gated by the owner state variable.
constructor initializes the owner state variable.
constructor assigns totalSupply to the deployer balance.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
approve writes into the allowance mapping.
Parameter _from provides the debited account to transferFrom.
Parameter _to provides the credited account to transferFrom.
Parameter _value provides the transferred amount to transferFrom.
Parameter _to is forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
Parameter _value is forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
Parameter a supplies the delegatecall target address to delegate.
Parameter b supplies the delegatecall calldata to delegate.
User-supplied parameter a flows directly into the delegatecall target.
Parameter _tos supplies the recipient array to batchSend.
Parameter _value supplies the per-recipient amount to batchSend.
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale.
Local total holds the unchecked _value * _tos.length product.
Local i drives the iteration over the recipient array.
Local _to receives _tos[i] and is credited in the loop.
Local _UNI caches the pairFor result compared against _from in ensure.
transfer invokes transferFrom and returns its result.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
delegate transfers control into the low-level delegatecall primitive.
delegatecall executes foreign code that can re-enter the contract with the caller's privileges.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only consumed as the recipient argument of transfer.
Parameter _value is only consumed as the amount argument of transfer.
Parameter _from is only consumed inside transferFrom for balances and whitelisting.
Parameter _to is only consumed inside transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter _value is only consumed inside transferFrom for allowance and balance math.
Parameter a is the user-controlled delegatecall target of delegate.
Parameter b only supplies calldata to the delegate function's delegatecall.
Parameter _tos is only iterated over inside batchSend.
Parameter _value is only used to compute totals and credits inside batchSend.
Parameter saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
Parameter token feeds the unchecked scaling multiplication in init.
Parameter maxToken feeds the unchecked scaling multiplication in init.
Local total is the unchecked product that drives the batchSend balance debit.
Local i is only the loop counter of batchSend.
Local _to is only the loop-scoped recipient inside batchSend.
Local _UNI is only the cached pair address compared inside ensure.
